fetch_recipe: GET the recorded url exactly (raw Internet Archive id_ form) with no Accept-Encoding request header and no automatic decoding (for example curl -s -o FILE URL, without --compressed), then hash the bytes as received. A client that sends Accept-Encoding can receive an on-the-fly gzip body with different bytes, and a decoding client unpacks bodies that the archive stores compressed.

rows.text: The editor's note says the 52nd National Conference closed that week with an address by 'newly-elected ANC President Jacob Zuma', of which an edited extract follows; the extract is signed 'Jacob Zuma, Polokwane, 21 December 2007'.

rows.text: The same issue's 'Letter from the Outgoing President', signed Thabo Mbeki, says the Conference held on 16-20 December elected a new NEC, calls Zuma 'our new President' and congratulates 'our President, Comrade Jacob Zuma'.
